en.headline: Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart runs its final day at the Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free three-day event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza A and B continues until 6pm today under the theme of crafts in connection and tradition in continuation.
body: The Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart 2026 is holding its final day on Sunday at the open-air Piazza A and B of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Organised by Earthpulse Society as part of the Hong Kong Culture Festival and Muse Fest 2026, the free event runs from noon to 6pm today. It opened on Friday and continues the theme “Crafts in Connection, Tradition in Continuation”.

The organisers said the programme includes heritage craft booths, martial arts and lion dance performances, traditional music, and interactive demonstrations of crafts such as bamboo weaving and paper art. Workshops require prior registration and admission is free.
The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Intangible Cultural Heritage Funding Scheme supported the event. It is scheduled to conclude at 6pm on Sunday.

zh.headline: 非物質文化遺產市集今日最後一天於文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 尖沙咀香港文化中心露天廣場A及B區的免費三日活動今日中午12時至下午6時繼續，主題為連藝融通、續寫傳統。
body: 非物質文化遺產市集2026今日（周日）於尖沙咀香港文化中心露天廣場A及B區舉行最後一天。
活動由地脈協會主辦，屬香港文化節及香港博物館2026一部分，今日中午12時至下午6時開放。活動周五展開，主題為「連藝融通・續寫傳統」。
主辦方表示，節目包括非遺手作攤位、武術及舞獅表演、傳統音樂，以及竹編、紙藝等互動示範。工作坊需預先登記，入場免費。
活動獲康樂及文化事務署非物質文化遺產資助計劃支持，預定周日下午6時結束。
